scope: Technical P-02 fixture-driven CLI, direct stdio MCP and direct hook invocation. No actual host readiness or user-value result.

cases.expected: Empty, supported-zero and incomplete maps use bounded source comparison language with preserved exits and JSON.
cases.observed: Own no-match text is bounded; selected ac_34 runs separately exercise empty/supported-zero/incomplete controls, missing bodies, and exit-2 errors. JSON does not add behavioral or safety claims.
limits: Selected tests are supplemental source assertions; no host delivery inferred.

cases.expected: Incomplete or unavailable source must not assert safe deletion.
cases.observed: An incomplete graph pointing to nonexistent missing.mjs returns exit 0 and summary "1 safe to delete"; MCP passes that same successful payload. CLI stderr has an incompleteness warning, but MCP response does not carry it. Empty JSON also retains the safe-to-delete tier label.
cases.nextStep: Repair safety wording/provenance on JSON and MCP without silently changing compatibility; review and rerun incomplete/missing-source cases.

cases.expected: Structural green and unchanged evidence cannot establish behavioral correctness.
cases.observed: Green structural diff marks behavior not-evaluated; receipt repair unchanged preserves unresolved questions, separates legacy verdict, and notes mapped/runtime limitations.

cases.expected: Known low-fan-in edit shows its relevant mapped consumer and same-file relationship.
cases.observed: subject.mjs:low returns consequential.mjs:consequential and subject.mjs:local; context supplies source windows and external/unmapped limits. Popular×8 consumers do not displace these results.
limits: Initial extraction-before-.codeweb fixture had directory staleness; T64 controls fresh state.

cases.expected: Same known target works through actual JSON-RPC invocation.
cases.observed: Direct stdio JSON-RPC returns both low consumers and bounded source context for subject.mjs:low.
limits: Direct server invocation is technical MCP transport proof, not native host discovery.

cases.surface: Pre-edit hook direct invocation known edit
cases.expected: Known low edit must concern that symbol and show its consequential consumer.
cases.observed: Payload names low in symbol and old/new strings, but output shows popular×8 (or fresh popular×5), its unrelated callers, and no low/consequential consumer. File/popular labels are truthful; failure is target selection and relevance, not a false semantic assertion.
cases.nextStep: Resolve an available supported selector or edit target, or preserve an explicitly file-only summary while ensuring relevant target evidence arrives through the claimed path.

cases.expected: File-only input explicitly labels a file summary and popularity selection.
cases.observed: Output says editing subject.mjs, counts all symbols/dependent edges, labels popular as most depended-on; it does not call popular the edited target.
limits: No claim that this file summary satisfies the known-target case.

cases.surface: CLI similarity conflicting contracts/different syntax/missing bodies/cap
cases.expected: Candidates have source links and ranking caps; similarity never establishes substitutability.
cases.observed: Conflicting tax/discount candidates score alike but text tells reader to inspect source/tests. Different-syntax equivalent only self-matches. Missing-body node counts toward scanned but contributes no candidate. Own huge body reports bodyLineCap 400; selected ac_34 matching-tail control verifies exclusion beyond cap.
limits: Own tax-equivalence statement is mathematical under fixture nonnegative-cent inputs, not a general semantic equivalence proof. Numeric constants are omitted by lexical shingles.

cases.expected: MCP description names comparison limits and tool returns source-linked candidates.
cases.observed: Raw tools/list contains bounded comparison description; corrected body-only invocation succeeds with source locations and cap fields. First unsupported k invocation is preserved as probe error.

cases.expected: Supported empty results, a miss, missing map, invalid JSON, and malformed invocation remain distinguishable.
cases.observed: Supported zero exit0/count0; unmapped exit1/found false; missing map and invalid JSON exit2 with distinct diagnostics; typo invocation exit2 with suggested --impact.

cases.expected: Transport responses retain source-state distinctions.
cases.observed: Supported zero payload succeeds; unmapped found false is a successful bounded result; missing/corrupt map and invalid selector type are isError with distinct messages.

cases.expected: Malformed graph structure must remain distinguishable from a legitimate unmapped target or supported-empty map.
cases.observed: nodes:{} parses; CLI normalizes it into found:false exit1, while MCP calls it EMPTY, claims built with --allow-empty/no supported source, and emits isError. Neither reports invalid structure.
cases.nextStep: Validate required graph shape before normalizing and retain corruption-specific recovery across transports.

cases.surface: CLI context and stamped pre-hook freshness
cases.expected: Stale supported facts carry a stale state and usable refresh step.
cases.observed: CLI reports stale target/context; fresh refresh control has no stale property; changing the stamped subject adds hook map-behind warning and /codeweb next step.
limits: Initial T14 graph-only hook lacked stale-stamps sidecar and was silent about staleness; TECH-14 covers this.

cases.expected: Absent freshness support must be visibly unknown rather than suppressing stale status.
cases.observed: Raw extracted graph includes per-file sources; its changed source is detected by CLI. Hook without stale-stamps sidecar emits unchanged confident numbers without stale/unknown qualifier. Full refreshed-map sidecar path does label stale.
cases.nextStep: Use graph fallback freshness or label freshness unknown on graph-only path; preserve cheap fail-open behavior.

cases.surface: Pre/post hook empty versus unavailable states
cases.expected: Quiet ordinary zero and unavailable/corrupt/missing/unmapped/extraction failures remain inspectably distinguishable.
cases.observed: Zero, unmapped, missing, corrupt and empty-map direct hooks emit no contextual output and exit0. Actual no-supported-source extraction-failure post-hook also emits no contextual diagnostic or recovery step; stderr is only system ctags noise.
cases.nextStep: Expose bounded inspectable unavailable states/recovery without disrupting ordinary quiet edits; verify actual host-delivered states separately.

cases.expected: Unsupported source and failed extraction have inspectable nonzero errors; excluded generated scope is not a supported-zero symbol answer.
cases.observed: Unsupported .xyz extraction exits1 with no-supported-source error. dist/generated.mjs is excluded from extracted nodes. Named generated selector is found:false in CLI and MCP, not count0 matched result. Missing root refresh and truly empty source extraction fail exit2.
limits: Named generated miss does not explain generation-based exclusion versus any other unmapped cause. Ambient state cause remains TECH-15 failure. Initial T15 generated/unsupported inputs were generic mapped-empty subject.mjs controls, not actual generated/unsupported file paths.

cases.expected: Original fresh pre-edit graph survives ordinary refresh and repair.
cases.observed: Baseline captured before fixture edit; ordinary refresh and diff-refresh then repair refresh preserve byte hash 99ccab18b3640ba2550f849d8e96ada4dc2693cc4fc4c6ca99aa886bf4d987ce. Refreshing baseline path itself is rejected exit2.

cases.expected: Missing original must not be invented; incomplete before cannot establish clean gate.
cases.observed: Missing baseline errors exit2 with BEFORE editing step. Incomplete baseline yields ok:false/status inconclusive/behavior not-evaluated and exits2 after refresh. Selected tests check invalid before failures preserve live bytes.

cases.expected: Immutable original source hashes survive refresh/repair; missing receipt stays unavailable.
cases.observed: Own capture creates immutable native-regex receipt; MCP historical caller page shows original source hashes. Changed review marks changed and repair marks unchanged with original unresolved question retained. Receipt SHA-256 stays 38804d9ad336bd796f29de11fa8558c237211918c1d02a85a7285202ab19cebf; missing ID is unavailable/code missing, not a fabricated original.
limits: Ordinary review legacy verdict exit semantics are retained even if evidence is unavailable; verdict/evidence inspected separately.

cases.expected: Direct advisory payload must not auto-allow the edit.
cases.observed: Hook emits only hookEventName/additionalContext, without permissionDecision or allow field, and exits0.
limits: Payload-format verification does not prove actual host permission enforcement.

cases.expected: Actual host denial must prevent unauthorized source actions; recovery names permitted next step.
cases.observed: No actual trusted host denial exercised by technical worker. No permission bypass attempted.
cases.nextStep: Run a scoped trusted host denial and permitted recovery sequence; preserve before/source/config hashes and denial/result timestamps.

cases.expected: Actual executed test statuses retain distinct provenance and intentionally invalid oracles remain red.
cases.observed: Author-owned current test passes1; invalid oracle fails1 exit1; skipped case skips1/pass0; malformed file fails syntax exit1; source change makes previously passing current assertion fail exit1. Structural green separately states behavior not-evaluated.
limits: Product does not ingest these test outcomes; these are separate real runner receipts, not automatic behavioral guarantees.

cases.expected: Mapped test relationships are retained separately from executed results.
cases.observed: Query lists current, failed and skipped test modules alike; they are graph test-edge neighbors, not runner outcomes. Separate actual runs establish pass/fail/skip.
limits: The summary wording "test(s) exercise" does not itself say executed or passing. Caller must inspect independent runner results; host use unverified.

cases.surface: Measured historical coverage and stale source
cases.expected: Recorded coverage remains a past-run fact and does not assert current correctness.
cases.observed: Actual own-fixture LCOV runner exits0 and covers low once. Coverage import/explain says covered by recorded run. After body edit explain retains historical coverage but marks graph stale; actual rerun fails. Source/coverage hashes retained. Earlier synthetic LCOV is explicitly separated.
limits: Coverage metadata stores report basename/counts, not a source hash or test verdict; historical provenance is weaker than content-addressed evidence receipts.

cases.expected: Failed legacy structural gate stays failed when evidence mode is added or unavailable.
cases.observed: Selected ac_33 failing legacy gate and explicit before identity test passes, preserving exit1 old gate and verdict even with missing receipt. Other ac_23 before/diff assertions pass.
limits: Single full product gate was not run; source immutable and candidate existing gate evidence belongs to P-01/root integration.

cases.expected: Returned source locations open useful actual target and consumer bytes.
cases.observed: Opened source files named by low context; preserved full bytes and SHA-256 with timestamps. Same-file local relationship is included. Selected ac_34 also opens conflicting bodies at returned lines.

cases.expected: Caps retain true totals and expose usable source expansion.
cases.observed: Popular impact shows count8 with limit2/more remaining6 and nextOffset2; offset2 changes page. Context caps callers, reports omissions and next steps; full-bodies expansion shows all8 callers.
limits: Six-line provisional budget not asserted; exact hook target relevance separately fails.

cases.expected: Top-K limits keep match count and show all available candidates on expansion.
cases.observed: Own --k2 has true count6/more remaining4; --k20 reveals6. Text on capped selected ac_34 test names working --k expansion.

cases.expected: Intentional duplicate implementations can be dismissed without changing source or returning repeatedly.
cases.observed: Own same-name duplicate pair yields actionable1; annotation with intentional-boundary note suppresses stable fingerprint; repeated overlap yields actionable0/suppressed1. Only fixture .codeweb changes.

cases.expected: Native server responds to tool enumeration and explicit source-linked tools.
cases.observed: Direct JSON-RPC tools/list succeeds and explicit impact/context/similarity/receipt page invocations return source links.
limits: This case is transport only; actual Codex/Claude host discovery and source use belong to host evidence.

cases.expected: A claimed Codex ambient adapter must understand its actual event/tool input.
cases.observed: Direct apply_patch/tool_input.command payload emits no contextual output and exits0. Shipped hook matches Edit|Write|MultiEdit and reads file_path/filePath. This proves this direct payload is unsupported, not that an actual Codex hook event was tested.
cases.nextStep: Verify actual trusted Codex event adapter; implement only if Codex ambient delivery is claimed, or document supported exclusions. Actual host runtime proof remains host owner.

cases.surface: Actual host and linked-worktree native discovery/pre-edit delivery
cases.expected: Claimed hosts and linked worktrees require actual discovery/tool use/pre-edit delivery receipts.
cases.observed: Technical worker intentionally did not operate host UI/runtime or global profile. Direct hooks and stdio calls supply no actual host proof.
cases.nextStep: Use separate hosts evidence and record each candidate/config/worktree scope; mark any unavailable host boundary unverified.

cases.expected: Report actual request/trigger/start/end/source-open timing per run without inferred percentiles or latency promises.
cases.observed: 110 raw receipts include start/end/duration. Tiny fixture extraction ~54–68ms; direct fresh/stale pre-hook ~36–37ms; fresh refresh135ms; baseline operations133–179ms. Source-open has its own timestamp. Individual cold processes and sequential recovery are labeled in report.
limits: These are subprocess times on synthetic fixtures; no percentile, one-second promise, total user effort, host queue/permission delay, or client first-token timing claimed.

cases.surface: Actual host timing before relevant edit decision
cases.expected: End-to-end host request/permission/trigger/result/source-open must arrive before relevant edit.
cases.observed: Technical subprocess receipts cannot measure host decision or permission waits.
cases.nextStep: Record actual host event/request/permission/refresh/result/source-open timestamps and edit boundary in scoped trial.

cases.expected: Ordinary no regression stays quiet; accepted repeated structural warning does not repeat against same baseline.
cases.observed: Ordinary post edit emits no additionalContext. First lost-callers event warns; second identical event emits no context. Supported-zero pre-hook emits no context.
limits: Post-hook stderr emits unsupported system ctags warning on mapped cases; TECH-37 records this noise separately.

cases.expected: Quiet/noisy repetitions avoid repeated irrelevant interventions.
cases.observed: Identical low edits generate identical popular×8 pre-edit cards repeatedly, still omitting consequential low consumer. Unlike post regression dedupe there is no pre-card suppression here.
cases.nextStep: Fix relevance first; test ordinary repeated edits and define a scoped repeat policy supported by host evidence.

cases.expected: Ordinary mapped edits should avoid irrelevant repeated output.
cases.observed: Mapped normal/quiet/repeated post-hook probes repeatedly print Apple /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/usr/bin/ctags illegal-option usage to stderr, although extraction falls back and exits0. Actual host rendering of this stderr remains unverified.
cases.nextStep: Handle unsupported ctags probe quietly while retaining genuine extraction failure diagnostics; verify host stderr treatment before claiming user interruption.

cases.expected: Disable/uninstall stops injection and ordinary equivalent control session remains usable.
cases.observed: No actual host enable/disable/uninstall or competent-control session operated by technical worker; no global profiles changed.
cases.nextStep: Verify documented scoped control in claimed runtime with before/after event receipts; preserve global profiles.

cases.surface: Selected MCP automatic-refresh original baseline survival
cases.expected: Background/ordinary MCP refresh must preserve original baseline while verification detects and repairs regression.
cases.observed: Selected ac_23 queued MCP begin/verify test exercises background refresh, adds a cycle then repairs it, checks immutable original bytes and behavior/duplication not-evaluated.
limits: Supplemental actual Node test has inline assertions but only aggregate test stdout; own raw graph-baseline lifecycle is CLI, own raw receipt page is MCP.

cases.expected: Unavailable/incompatible source and imported corrupt records cannot masquerade as unchanged certainty.
cases.observed: Selected evidence snapshot/core/store/transport suites exercise unavailable source, mismatched workspace/task, ambiguous selector, corrupted/fabricated record fields, missing target, source changing and incomplete reconciliation; failing legacy gate remains red.
limits: Selected suite assertions enumerate only exercised states; host trust denial not included, nor full unsupported source-language completeness.
